name: Castorcito date
description: Sub-module of Castorcito that adds a 'date' cfield type for adding date/datetime values to Castorcito components.
project_description: Castorcito date is a sub-module of Castorcito that provides a new custom cfield type ('date') for adding date fields to Castorcito components. The cfield is a CastorcitoComponentField plugin (Date) built on ConfigurableComponentFieldBase, letting the component builder choose a date type (date or date and time) and a display date format from the site's configured date formats. It ships a config schema for its settings and an SDC for rendering.
